purpose_separation.signal: P4-visible data only at the09:00 decision event
purpose_separation.execution_quote: Separately reviewed T+1 daily-open replay context; not known-at09:00 signal information and not an actual auction/liquidity certificate

required_evidence: independently bound security/date limit regime and listing/relisting/status evidence
explicit semantics for any zero/infinity/null/sentinel in supplier quote fields

regime_handling.LIMITED: Validate finite positive ordered bounds,units and quote identity; preserve raw values, do not repair.
regime_handling.UNKNOWN: BLOCKED_INPUT; whole requested-quote batch stops, no row dropping.
regime_handling.KNOWN_UNLIMITED_OR_UNREVIEWED_NO_LIMIT_R: BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_REGIME; this bounded-band model does not interpret sentinel values as real caps or assume a percentage. Keep order/quote/failure receipts.

ST_and_IPO: Do not apply the old universal mainboard ST5% assertion to this2026 window. Primary SSE2026 notice changes5to10from07-06; primary SZSE issuer2026-067 reports10after07-07. New listings can have no-limit initial sessions, but do not count weekdays or invent a listing-date exemption. Missing regime evidence blocks execution.
bad_values: Missing/nonfinite/inverted bounds or an open outside the bound regime block input. No price fill,band clipping,factor arithmetic,T-day fallback or in-place mutation.

band_nonfills.buy: Open or adverse tick-rounded model price at/above actual T+1 upper bound gives NO_FILL_LIMIT_UP.
band_nonfills.sell: Open or adverse tick-rounded model price at/below actual T+1 lower bound gives NO_FILL_LIMIT_DOWN.
